entities.name: Drosophila Ken (P60319)
observations: The 205-aa query has an exact sequence-hash match to reviewed Drosophila yakuba probable transcription factor Ken (P60319); alignment identity 100%, query and target coverage 83.9%.

Reference annotation describes Ken as a probable transcription factor required for terminalia development; associated GO processes include RNA polymerase II transcription regulation, male and female genitalia/analia development, and negative regulation of JAK-STAT receptor signaling.
Reference localization is nucleus; GO annotations include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and sequence-specific RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory-region binding.
Query Pfam scanning detected a C2H2 zinc-finger domain at residues 106–128; domain evidence is consistent with DNA-binding function.
